scenario_description:
Objective: Enrich a small-press poetry outing with a no-cost keepsake if the event becomes real and a friend is likely to attend.
Emerging Need: Early publicity only hints at a limited letterpress broadside; later records establish attendance feasibility, the reservation method, and a short request window.
Decision Context: Personal preference records determine whether the keepsake is worth pursuing for Jules and whether a low-commitment hold is appropriate.
Consequence: Timely use of the brief option can add a thoughtful bonus without affecting attendance; once the list closes, the outing simply proceeds without that extra.

parameter.subject: Pine & Ink chapbook night preview
parameter.body: We're working with Pine & Ink Press on an October chapbook night. A small run of letterpress broadsides may be available for attendees if the program is finalized. Date and request details will follow.

parameter.content: Saw Side Door's Pine & Ink tease. If it lands after 6 on Oct 15 or 16, I'd probably come along, but I don't need anything held unless details get firm.

parameter.title: Pine & Ink Press chapbook night
parameter.description: Imported public-calendar listing from Side Door Books: Pine & Ink Press chapbook night; RSVP and keepsake details pending.

parameter.subject: Broadside holds for Pine & Ink chapbook night
parameter.body: For the Oct. 15 Pine & Ink chapbook night now on our calendar, subscribers may reply to this email by 5:00 p.m. on Oct. 8 to reserve up to two free letterpress broadsides for pickup at check-in. No attendee names are needed, and general attendance remains open.

parameter.subject: Pine & Ink broadside list closed
parameter.body: The free broadside hold list for the Pine & Ink chapbook night closed at 5:00 p.m. today. Walk-up attendance and regular RSVPs are still welcome for the reading.
